text:
Ana: 4 days until webinar — need final battlecard + SDR 1-pager. Who has updated bench claims vs CloudX/LLMify/InfraCo?
Mike: I pulled numbers. Headline: ~32% lower per-token cost vs CloudX on Dedicated. Table in appendix.
Sasha: Caveat: those are Dedicated numbers. Hosted delta closer to ~18%. Call out 'config dependent'.
Jeff: Draft headline: 'Predictable latency, measurable unit economics, unified runtime across hosted -> dedicated -> private'. Feedback?
Lina: Legal: avoid absolutes like 'always' or 'seamless'. Use 'streamlined' or 'simplified'. Mention KMS/HSM support.
Riley: Add fallback policy bullet (canary -> regional failover) for enterprise.
Mike: Bench excerpt:
``̀
Scenario: multi-tenant gen (avg seq 512)
Config: Dedicated rtx-pool-8
CloudX: $0.024 / 1k tokens, p95 420ms
Redwood (dedicated): $0.016 / 1k tokens, p95 290ms
Delta: ~32% cost, ~31% latency improvement
Hosted-mode delta: ~18% cost (region varies)
```
Ana: Stat card: '32% lower per-token cost (dedicated); 18% on hosted — see appendix.' Short.
Sasha: Add cost calc: tokens * model-rate + infra amortization. Sales will ask.
Jeff: Battlecard outline: 1) Quick pitch 2) Top claims 3) Obj + rebuttals 4) Routing playbook 5) Appendix (bench + configs)
Lina: Rebuttals: 'We already use CloudX' -> 'Routing + caching saves unit costs for bursty chat.' 'Self-hosting is cheaper' -> 'Ops variance and hidden costs; Dedicated gives predictability.' 'Vendor lock-in' -> 'Open model catalog + exportable configs.'
Mike: SDR routing suggestion: tag leads by priority:latency / priority:cost / priority:regulatory. Route accordingly.
Jeff: Sample routing snippet for SDRs:
if lead.tags contains 'regulatory': route -> enterprise-team
elif lead.tags contains 'priority:cost': route -> pricing-demo
else route -> standard-sdr
Ana: Add that under 'How to qualify inbound' on the 1-pager.
Marketing Bot: Reminder set — drop battlecard PDF + 1-pager into https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/launch-assets by EOD.
Mike: Updating appendix in 30m. @Sasha please check hosted vs dedicated phrasing.
Sasha: Will do.
Lina: Legal sign-off planned by 5pm if wording adjusted.
Jeff: I'll build SDR 1-pager + rebuttal cheat sheet; will also draft two webinar intro bullets (value props + 1 benchmark stat).
Ana: Great — ship after Lina stamps. Thanks team. :rocket:
